gas.title: Gas market
gas.description: Search your ZIP on pagasswitch.com and copy the `distributor=` number from the results page URL.

data_description.price_unit: Leave blank to read it from the PA Gas Switch shop page (Peoples quotes per Mcf).

settings.title: Your usage and rate
settings.description: Pick the long-term statistic with your gas use (for example Peoples Gas consumption) and where your current supply rate comes from. With neither a sensor nor a value, the utility's Price to Compare is used.

data.current_rate_unit: Unit of the rate you typed
data.threshold_pct: Recommend switching at savings of at least
data.no_cancellation_fee: Skip offers with a cancellation fee

data_description.current_rate_entity: A sensor in USD per Mcf, ccf or therm, such as Peoples Gas Price to Compare. Takes precedence over a typed rate.
data_description.prior_suppliers: Semicolon-separated, optionally with the date you left: `Name@YYYY-MM-DD; Other Name`. Their new-customer-only offers are skipped.

electric.title: Electric market
electric.description: Search your ZIP on papowerswitch.com, pick your utility and rate class, and paste the results page URL here. It carries the distributor, rate class and ZIP.

electric_settings.title: Your usage and rate
electric_settings.description: Pick your hourly electricity statistic (for example the Duquesne Light collector's consumption) and where your supplier, supply rate and the utility's Price to Compare come from. Hourly data also lets Time-of-Use be scored when you enter its rates.

data.threshold_pct: Recommend switching at savings of at least
data.no_cancellation_fee: Skip offers with a cancellation fee

data_description.current_supplier_entity: A sensor whose state is your supplier's name, such as the Duquesne collector's Electric supplier. Blank or "default service" means you're on the utility's default supply.
data_description.current_rate_entity: A sensor in USD/kWh (or ¢/kWh), such as the Duquesne collector's Electric supply rate.
data_description.price_to_compare_entity: The utility's default supply price, such as the Duquesne collector's Electric Price to Compare.
data_description.tou_peak_cents: From the utility's Time-of-Use tariff, in ¢/kWh. Leave the three blank to skip Time-of-Use. They change each Jun 1 and Dec 1.
data_description.prior_suppliers: Semicolon-separated, optionally with the date you left: `Name@YYYY-MM-DD; Other Name`. Your current supplier counts automatically.

error.no_offers: PA Gas Switch lists no offers for that distributor and service type.
error.unknown_unit: PA Gas Switch didn't show a Price to Compare for this ZIP and distributor, so the price unit is unknown. Pick it here.
error.invalid_shop_url: That URL has no distributor or rate class. Use the PA Power Switch results page after picking your utility and rate class.

abort.already_configured: This market is already set up.

cheaper_gas_supplier.title: Cheaper gas supplier: {supplier}
cheaper_gas_supplier.description:
{supplier} ({plan}, {term}) is ${price}/{unit} against your ${baseline}/{unit}, about ${savings} a year ({pct}%) less on your usage.

To switch, call {phone} or use the PA Gas Switch listing. Check the term, any cancellation fee and whether the price is introductory before signing.

This goes away on its own when the offer stops being worth it. Ignoring it silences this supplier only.

gas_rate_jump.title: Your gas supply rate rose {pct}%
gas_rate_jump.description: Your supply rate went from ${old}/{unit} (on {old_date}) to ${new}/{unit}. Variable rates often reset like this; the Energy Shopper sensors show whether another offer is cheaper now.

cheaper_electric_supplier.title: Cheaper electric supplier: {supplier}
cheaper_electric_supplier.description:
{supplier} ({plan}, {term}) is ${price}/kWh against your ${baseline}/kWh, about ${savings} a year ({pct}%) less on your usage.

To switch, call {phone} or use the PA Power Switch listing. Check the term, any cancellation fee and whether the price is introductory before signing.

This goes away on its own when the offer stops being worth it. Ignoring it silences this supplier only.

tou_available.title: Time-of-Use would save about ${savings} a year
tou_available.description:
On your hourly usage, {supplier}'s {plan} works out to ${price}/kWh against your ${baseline}/kWh, about ${savings} a year ({pct}%) less.

Time-of-Use prices peak hours (3–9 pm on weekdays) higher and nights lower. It's a tariff option, not a contract; ask the utility to enroll. The Time-of-Use sensor shows your peak share and what shifting load overnight would save.

electric_rate_jump.title: Your electric supply rate rose {pct}%
electric_rate_jump.description: Your supply rate went from ${old}/kWh (on {old_date}) to ${new}/kWh. Variable rates often reset like this; the Energy Shopper sensors show whether another offer is cheaper now.
